metadata.counts_mean: Name-normalised research entries, not independently deduplicated legal ventures or an accepted NZ population.
metadata.selection: Selected readable portfolio entries plus the original ten-venture pilot; not an exhaustive census.
metadata.normalisation: Case/punctuation/spacing normalisation for research grouping only. Explicit name links recorded separately. Possible aliases remain separate.
metadata.target_event_window: 2000 onwards; pre-2000 origins may qualify through later activity
metadata.missingness: Unknown is null; no operating status, funding stage or first investment date inferred from listing.
metadata.investment_claim_policy: Portfolio mention does not prove date, cheque size, legal vehicle, present holding or same-round co-investment.
metadata.point_in_time_policy: Pages retrieved now are not evidence of information available at an earlier cutoff.
metadata.research_stage_policy: Portfolio discovery is distinct from batch-01 evidence investigation; both still need identity and scope review.
